questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Delegating this step requires sharing your external Western Union transfer details and financial documents with the agent.

questions.question: Does the payment method you selected include an additional credit card processing fee?
questions.why: Payment portals often add a percentage-based surcharge for credit card transactions that isn't explicitly highlighted until the final checkout screen, making bank transfers a cheaper alternative.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the opportunity to switch to a different payment method to avoid paying a substantial, unnecessary surcharge on their tuition bill.

questions.question: Do you agree to Flywire's terms of use and privacy policy to process this payment?
questions.why: The payment processor requires you to explicitly check a box agreeing to their specific terms of use and privacy policy before you can finalize the transaction.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to review and consent to the third-party payment processor's legal terms regarding how your financial and personal data will be handled.

questions.question: Do you want to select a different currency for your Flywire payment?
questions.why: The Flywire payment screen provides a dropdown list to pay in another currency, which could offer better exchange rates or convenience for international students.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the ability to choose their preferred currency for the transaction, potentially incurring unwanted exchange fees from their bank.

questions.question: Did you record the unique payment reference number before leaving the bank transfer instructions?
questions.why: The Flywire instructions provide a specific 'Reference / Payment ID' that must be included in your bank transfer so the funds are correctly matched to your student account.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the critical tracking number needed to prove you paid your tuition if the bank transfer gets delayed or misrouted.

questions.question: Are you aware that you must manually initiate the bank transfer outside of this portal to actually move the money?
questions.why: The screen provides bank account details for a transfer rather than a direct payment gateway, meaning the registration process is paused until you separately authorize your bank to send the funds.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the awareness that the transaction is not complete on the portal and requires a separate, off-platform action to actually move the money and secure your registration.

questions.question: Are you ready to confirm your Flywire payment details and click Next to complete the registration?
questions.why: The screen explicitly warns that failing to click Next after setting up the Flywire payment will leave the registration incomplete and risk missing the deadline.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: Delegating this step means you lose the opportunity to personally verify the final payment amount and ensure the final submission actually goes through.

questions.question: Should you complete the additional questions requested after your successful payment?
questions.why: The confirmation page shows your payment was successful but prompts you to click 'Continue' to answer a few more questions.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the chance to decide whether to provide the extra personal information requested in the post-payment questionnaire.
